title: Letter 38 — Now Is the Time of Patience
attribution_note: Letter 38 of 46 in the collection Letters Sent — see Letter 1 for provenance.

pairs.en: *“Brethren and sisters in Christ!”*

Now is the time of patience. Therefore let us be patient now. There will be a time of consolation, and then we shall be comforted abundantly. The Lord will comfort us, *as one whom his mother comforteth* [Isaiah 66:13]. Then the mouths of the blasphemers shall be stopped, and shame shall cover them. The Lord grant that He convert them and make them our friends.
Your brother in Christ and partaker in sorrow, Tikhon.
